findings.title: Static shadow casters re-rendered into every cascade every frame
findings.fix: Cache the static casters per cascade (re-render a cascade only when its snapped matrix or a static caster changes) and draw only the dynamic casters over a copy of the cached depth. Identical depth by construction.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 1597 shadow caster items per frame for 596 scene draw items
findings.fix: Cull casters against the receiver volume (camera frustum extruded towards the light) per cascade, not only the light box.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 12.4 MB copied per frame by wrapped memcpy
findings.fix: Write the data where it is consumed (mapped buffers) instead of staging copies.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 'transparent' records work that invokes no shader
findings.fix: Every draw / dispatch of the pass is empty (culled to nothing / zero groups): skip the recording when its count is 0.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 16 cvar_find calls per frame
findings.fix: Index the cvars by a case-insensitive name hash (same result), and cache Cvar* at init in the per-frame callers.
findings.verify: perf_verify PF-0002 (perf_fix_disable A/B)

findings.title: 102 palette uploads per frame for 71 distinct palettes (30% duplicates, 44 kB)
findings.fix: Copy each character's palette once and let its parts (and the shadow / viewmodel passes) share the bone offset: the same matrices, uploaded once.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 7 byte-identical files duplicated across assets/vfx/tex / assets/vfx/tex_placeholder (3.7 MB): smoke_puff_lm0.png, smoke_puff_mv.png, smoke_puff.png, dust_puff_lm0.png, dust_puff.png
findings.fix: Reference one copy. If only one directory is ever loaded (check the asset cache keys), the duplicate costs disk / package size only.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 'light_shadows' rebinds a pipeline for 63% of its draws
findings.fix: Sort the draw list by pipeline (then material) and bind on change only. Draw order inside one depth-tested opaque pass does not change the image; keep blended draws in their order.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: Snapshot section 'time' (20 B) changes in 0.7% of snapshots but is always sent
findings.fix: Send it on change (a version byte + resend until acked) like the weather block. Protocol change: bump DG_PROTOCOL_VERSION.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: anim:post_pass: 37.9 us per item (1 items, 0.04 ms)
findings.fix: Profile with a sampling profiler (cache-miss counters need admin rights on Windows: not available here) and move the fields the loop touches into hot SoA arrays; the math is unchanged.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: vg_palettes_record() calls malloc in the frame loop
findings.fix: Keep the buffer for the owner's lifetime (sized at init) or take it from g_engine.frame_arena.
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)

findings.title: 5 adjacent frame graph passes are independent but barrier separately
findings.fix: Emit the barriers of a run of independent passes as one vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 before the run (fg_execute look-ahead).
findings.verify: verify by image + state diff after implementation (perf_verify)
